Periods.title: Periods
Periods.body: Periods protect your books from silent changes to the past. A month can be soft-closed and reopened; the year-end close is final. A filed VAT return seals its period hard: then there is no unlock here, only a note naming why. The audit log below records each of these actions in a way that makes tampering visible.
